title: Register the MCP server (Claude Code, VS Code)
summary: Adds drag-lint serve to Claude Code and VS Code MCP config: merged, backed up, idempotent, removable
intro: Run drag-lint mcp-config --all (try --dry-run first) once after installing, so Claude Code and VS Code can start drag-lint's MCP server. Pass --db to pin one index per entry (--name); --remove takes only its own entry out again.
